About this index. All 1,000 cards are named resources with a clickable URL — no placeholder slots and no two cards share the same address. 365 entries carry an <span class="tag ai">AI</span> chip, either because the tool applies AI or because AI itself is the subject. Categories follow each resource’s stated focus, so a few borderline entries could sit in a neighbouring section. Pricing, free tiers and institutional access change often, so treat the access label as a rough guide and confirm on the provider’s site. This directory is for learning and reference only; nothing here is medical, investment or engineering advice.

Single self-contained file · no external scripts, fonts or network calls · works offline
